entityDescription:
Ingeniarius, Lda., (ING) is a private SME that aims for R&D&I in the many fields of engineering, with emphasis in field robotics. The company’s philosophy is to create disruptive robotic solutions, either through the refitting of existing machines, or the full in-house development. The company tackles challenging field applications, namely within the domains of agriculture, forestry, construction, and others. ING’ team is experienced in the full chain of mechatronics development and robotic software design.
Since 2016, ING led four national consortia, STOP, CORE, SEMFIRE and SAFEFOREST, being currently engaged as participant in other EU projects (H2020), such as 5GSMARTFACT (956670), FEROX (101070440) and OPENSWARM (101093046). Beyond intercommunity projects covered by European programmes, ING has also been developing user-centric robotic solutions for private clients worldwide, as is the case of Viking (Germany), FallProtec (Luxembourg) and Corbar (Spain). These solutions have been tailored for specific needs, with the SolarCleano F1A and B1A robots being the most successful example of real-world field applications developed by ING[1],[2] and currently available in the market.
The experience with mobile robotic technologies endows ING with the necessary expertise to demonstrate the use of robotics in challenging domains, especially around heavy-duty tasks.

entityDescription:
Darmstadt University of Applied Sciences (Hochschule Darmstadt, h_da) puts science into action. With a student body of about 17,000, it is one of the largest and most distinguished universities of applied sciences in Germany. Its excellent reputation is the result of a scientifically grounded, real-world approach to higher education and the professional success of its graduates.
Graduates of Darmstadt University of Applied Sciences are particularly popular with HR managers in German companies. This is confirmed by the annual "Wirtschaftswoche" rankings. For the University Ranking 2019, the personnel service provider Universum Global surveyed 650 small, medium-sized and large companies nationwide. From a total of 216 universities of applied sciences in Germany, they were able to select those whose graduates met their expectations particularly well. Accordingly, h_da ranks among the top 10 in Germany in the fields of mechanical engineering (rank 3), computer science (rank 8), electrical engineering (rank 7) and industrial engineering (rank 4).
In the university ranking of the Centre for Higher Education Development (CHE) 2019, the h_da scores particularly well in terms of practical relevance and preparation for the profession. Accordingly, students of the study courses Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology, Mechanical Engineering and Environmental Engineering praise the very good equipment of the practice laboratories. The h_da is here in the national top group. The same applies to the quality of excursions, which students of architecture and environmental engineering rate as very good. The h_da is also top nationwide when it comes to contacts to professional practice. The CHE Ranking lists the University of Applied Sciences Darmstadt in the study courses electrical engineering and information technology, mechanical engineering and mechatronics in the national top group.
The high reputation of the h_da study courses is based on a good supervision ratio with manageable groups and a clear practical orientation. Here, science and practice intermesh in a targeted manner. This is because the professors of h_da know what they are doing: They all come from professional practice and know the future professional demands on their students. In the practical professional phases of the study programmes, students can also test and expand what they have learned with employers in business and society.

entityDescription:
Sensoworks is an innovative startup born in January 2020 that offers the market an "as a service" solution for monitoring critical infrastructures. Sensoworks acquires, monitors and analyzes data from sensors connected to infrastructures such as bridges, viaducts, tunnels, buildings, water and sewage networks. It connects to all the sensors to allow the configuration of the infrastructure and all its customizations. Once configured, all sensors are monitored in real time, data is collected, logged and securely structured to be analyzed by machine learning algorithms. The data is analyzed by AI algorithms for the identification of structural anomalies or predictive maintenance activities.Sensoworks can be easily configured to set up automatic actions based on collected data, events and performed analyses. It allows for the generation of highly configurable reports that can be stored in the blockchain. Sensoworks presents itself as a software product vendor in the critical infrastructure monitoring market. The results obtained to date show how a technologically advanced platform has become a fundamental element of the monitoring processes. Road, motorway, sewage and water network operators are able to easily insert the Sensoworks platform within their monitoring and intervention processes, improving them, thanks to the introduction of a system capable of monitoring in real time, acting in autonomy when certain conditions occur, to the creation of advanced reports that can be certified in blockchain.Sensoworks therefore allows you to monitor complex infrastructures making data analysis very simple and allowing you to prevent the onset of certain phenomena by reducing risks and optimizing investment costs for maintenance activities.
The competitive context
The IoT (Internet of Things) is revolutionizing the way critical infrastructure, such as bridges, viaducts, tunnels, water and sewage networks, are monitored and managed. The goal is to improve the efficiency, safety and resilience of these infrastructures through the use of sensors, monitoring devices and advanced algorithms to analyze the data collected. The competitive environment of IoT in critical infrastructure monitoring is characterized by intense competition between IoT solution providers and infrastructure management service providers. Companies offering IoT solutions compete to provide the best sensor technology, monitoring devices and data analysis software, while infrastructure management companies seek to adopt more efficient and secure solutions at reasonable costs. IoT technologies can provide a number of competitive advantages over traditional monitoring solutions, such as the ability to collect data in real time, which allows for rapid response in case of problems, and real-time data analysis to identify potential problems before they occur.
Sensoworks positions itself in this context as a software product vendor, a complete, end-to-end IIoT (Intelligent Internet of Things) solution, which includes:
- Sensoworks IIoT Edge Gateway: an edge/fog computing software for real-time acquisition and analysis of static and dynamic parameters acquired by sensors connected to the infrastructure and a native cloud platform
- Sensoworks IIoT Platform: a native cloud platform for Big Data & Analytics management, Predictions, Alarm Management, Document Management, BIM Integration to support Digital Twin of Monitored Infrastructures, GIS Integration to support spatial analysis;
Compared to competitors on the market who typically offer custom IoT solutions with high implementation costs or with different application modules that require integration activities, Sensoworks offers a ready-to-use end-to-end solution that supports customers for monitoring activities, predictive maintenance and simulation of the behavior of the infrastructurs as the modal parameters vary.

Spat¬in-eo actively participates and innovates in the context of OGC and INSPIRE to further develop the standards and engage with the parties leveraging them. Spatineo helps organizations to optimize their investments in the Spatial Data Infrastructure and prove the value of their spatial information and web services. Spatineo was founded in 2011 and it has headquarters in Helsinki, Finland. The mission is to help customers to improve the use and usability of spatial web service technologies for both public and commercial uses.
Spatineo has developed easy-to-use cloud-based applications for usage analytics, service level monitoring and performance testing of spatial web services. The applications provide important metrics for service development and reporting and can also be used as data for impact analysis. Customers that use Spatineo’s pro-ducts represent a range of different industries from numerous countries, industries such as cadastral and land registry authorities, mapping, environmental and natural resources organisations, transportation agencies, IT service providers, cities, regions and municipalities.
Spatineo is a member of OGC (Open Geospatial Consortium), an active contributor and strongly committed to the technical development of the INSPIRE Directive, with in-depth involvement in the standardization work support to make sure standards and technical guidances are practical and helpful.

Knight Optical is a leading global provider of scientific optical components, with a successful track record spanning over 30 years. Under the leadership of our managing director, Colin Overton, we have established ourselves as a trusted name in the industry, committed to delivering superior quality products and services.
Despite our modest beginnings, Knight Optical has achieved remarkable growth, expanding our operations in the UK and establishing a presence in the United States in 2015. Our ongoing objective is to continue expanding and serving the global market. Located in Kent, South East England, we benefit from convenient distribution to Europe, being only 20 minutes away from the Channel Tunnel rail link.
Our Services
We cater to a diverse range of industries, including scientific research, defense, medical, pharmaceutical, optoelectronics, entertainment, education, laser technology, engineering, manufacturing, and oil and gas. Our highly qualified and skilled workforce enables us to offer custom-made optical solutions in virtually any shape or size, economically. By combining traditional techniques with state-of-the-art systems and metrology equipment, we guarantee superior quality, competitive pricing, and prompt delivery within 2-3 weeks from the receipt of an order.
At Knight Optical, we handle projects of all scales, from one-off research orders to large-scale production runs with call-off delivery schedules. Our dedicated staff members are always ready to assist you with any inquiries, as we prioritize providing excellent customer service. Through collaborative partnerships with our customers, we can determine specific requirements, recommend suitable materials and tolerances, ensuring optimal outcomes.
In addition to our custom optics, we maintain an inventory of over 3,000 stock items readily available for prompt dispatch. These items can be conveniently purchased from our website. Rest assured, all optical components dispatched from Knight Optical undergo rigorous testing in our state-of-the-art metrology laboratory, ensuring their readiness for immediate use.
Bringing Quality Into Focus
Quality is the cornerstone of our operations at Knight Optical. We have implemented stringent quality management systems and have received ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 accreditations. Our workforce is well-versed in these quality management systems and adheres to established quality standards, including ISO 10110, BS4301, and MIL-SPEC, through comprehensive training programs.

ASSIST TECHNOLOGY & RESEARCH S.R.L. was established as an Innovative Startup in 2019, bringing together professional profiles and corporate structures aimed at the development and production of innovative products and services with high technological value.
Its primary objective is the creation and design of software solutions in the field of big data and self-learning neural networks, capable of facilitating knowledge management and continuous innovation in public and private organizations through information retrieval and extraction platforms (i.e., Information retrieval and extraction), natural language processing, and semantic analysis. Secondarily, it provides Technical Consulting in the development and management of computer systems and offers services for innovative information and communication technology laboratories.
To expand and strengthen its objective, in 2020 it acquired the Innovilab Laboratory in Rende, located in Contrada Mazzarella, operational since 2016 with expertise in Research and Innovation Projects in the healthcare sector, using CLOUD solutions operating in clinical centers, nursing homes, and patient homes in the field of telemedicine and remote real-time monitoring. Over the past few years, the Laboratory, in synergy with clinical and university partners in the Calabria Region, has participated in public financing calls and created demonstrations aimed at the healthcare world.
